items.problem: Los pedidos críticos (2 horas) se pierden en la cola o requieren mano de obra extra costosa para ser despachados a tiempo.

items.problem: Los robots se quedan sin batería en medio del turno o pasan horas cargando, reduciendo la capacidad real y generando cuellos de botella.
items.solution: Carga de Oportunidad inteligente: el sistema envía robots a cargar durante micro-pausas naturales de la operación, sin afectar los pedidos prioritarios.

items.title: Urgent Order Management (Prime Now)
items.problem: Critical orders (2 hours) get lost in the queue or require expensive extra labor to be dispatched on time.
items.solution: The system automatically identifies urgent orders and reassigns nearby robots in seconds, prioritizing their route without stopping normal warehouse operations.

items.title: Consistent Throughput During Peak Hours
items.problem: During peak demand, aisles get saturated, robots wait for each other, and productivity drops by up to 30%.
items.solution: Real-time congestion detection. The system dynamically reroutes traffic or sends loaded robots to the nearest dock to clear the aisle immediately.

items.title: Uninterrupted Shifts (Maximum Uptime)
items.problem: Robots run out of battery mid-shift or spend hours charging, reducing actual capacity and creating bottlenecks.
items.solution: Smart Opportunity Charging: the system sends robots to charge during natural micro-pauses in operations, without affecting priority orders.

items.title: Scalability Without Integration Costs
items.problem: Adding or changing robot manufacturers (e.g., from Locus to MiR) takes months of custom development and million-dollar integration costs.
items.solution: Thanks to native VDA5050 standard, FleetMind discovers and orchestrates any new robot automatically. True Plug & Play.
items.value: Deployment in days, not months. Zero vendor lock-in.
